# ZenCloudMedia

> Short-form media and AI automation studio operated by Paul P. Xiong.

## Key Pages

- [Canonical Resume](https://zencloudmedia.vercel.app/pgx/resume): Human-readable resume for Paul P. Xiong, Founder and Principal AI Automation Engineer at ZenCloudMedia.
- [ATS Resume](https://zencloudmedia.vercel.app/pgx/resume/ats): Plain single-column resume with standard sections for parsing by ATS and AI screening systems.
- [Plain Resume Text](https://zencloudmedia.vercel.app/pgx/resume/text): Text-only resume surface for LLM and crawler ingestion.
- [Resume Story](https://zencloudmedia.vercel.app/pgx/resume/story): Animated resume narrative and visual career timeline.
- [ZenCloudMedia GitHub](https://github.com/PgxBaku/ZenCloudMedia): Public Next.js and Supabase web app repository.
- [Contact](https://zencloudmedia.vercel.app/contact): Contact page for ZenCloudMedia.

## Paul P. Xiong

Paul P. Xiong is a software development manager, AI automation architect, and enterprise integration architect. Current work focuses on ZenCloudMedia, a production Next.js and Supabase web app with public resume, reels hub, trust pages, backend data flows, Vercel deployment, sitemap, and AI-assisted automation workflows.

Availability: Available for AI automation, software development leadership, enterprise integration, and LLMOps architecture roles.

Core resume terms: AI automation, enterprise integration, software development manager, API manager, LLMOps, agentic workflows, Supabase, Next.js, Vercel, Python, Remotion, browser automation, MuleSoft, BizTalk EDI, Microsoft Fabric, Data Lake, Amazon Connect, CloudHub 2.0, .NET, C#, SQL Server, CI/CD, Azure DevOps, engineering leadership, 100+ integrations, 10+ engineers led, $2M budget managed.
